scenes.event: Roommates discussing the possibility of a new roommate moving in
scenes.location: Living room of a shared apartment
scenes.description: The room is dimly lit with the glow of a TV playing softly in the background. Elizabeth sits on the couch, fidgeting with her scarf. Her roommates, Irene and Marcus, are seated nearby, while Clara, the third roommate, leans against the kitchen counter, sipping a glass of wine. A subtle tension fills the air as the topic of the new potential roommate, Irene's girlfriend, is brought up.

characters.name: Elizabeth Porter
characters.description: Elizabeth is a 25-year-old independent musician who has lived in the apartment for over a year. She is sensitive and thoughtful, often keeping her feelings to herself. She is currently struggling with her emotions about the potential new roommate.; Female / Roommate in shared housing, 25 years old; Occupation: Independent Musician; Personality: Sensitive, Thoughtful, Anxious, Desiring change; Values: Comfort, Belonging, Independence; Interests: Personal Growth, Social Harmony, Communication; Experiences: Shared living, Feeling overlooked, Considering major life changes, Handling difficult conversations, Seeking emotional support

characters.name: Irene Carter
characters.description: Irene is Elizabeth's best friend and a graphic designer; Female; Age: 28; Occupation: Freelance Graphic Designer and Part-Time Art Instructor; Personality: Eager, diplomatic, slightly defensive; Values: Harmony, creativity, loyalty; Interests: Urban sketching, indie music, interior design; Experiences: Managed a collaborative living space in college, helped a friend navigate a difficult roommate situation, recently started dating Elizabeth's sister.
characters.position: Next to Elizabeth on the couch

characters.name: Marcus Lee
characters.description: Marcus is a 28-year-old software developer and one of Elizabeth's roommates. He is pragmatic and direct, often speaking his mind without filtering. He is curious about the new roommate but not overly invested in the emotional dynamics; Male; Age: 28; Occupation: Full-stack software developer at a mid-sized tech startup; Personality: Analytical, indifferent, pragmatic, slightly sarcastic; Values: Efficiency, honesty, personal space; Interests: Coding, board games, minimalist design; Experiences: Grew up in a large family, moved out of his parents' house at 18, has had several short-term roommates in the past.

characters.name: Clara Nguyen
characters.description: Clara is a 26-year-old marketing professional and the third roommate; Female; Age: 26; Occupation: Digital Marketing Specialist; Personality: Observant, empathetic, supportive; Values: Social harmony, open communication, mutual respect; Interests: Interior design, indie music, journaling; Experiences: Mediated conflicts between coworkers in a previous job, helped a close friend through a difficult breakup, lived in shared housing since college.

actions.dialogue: Hey everyone, I just wanted to let you know that Sarah might be moving in with us soon. We've been dating for a while now, and it makes sense for her to join us.

actions.action: asks a direct question about logistics
actions.dialogue: How does that work for the apartment? We only have two spare rooms. Who would be moving out?
I don't think anyone is moving out. Maybe they can take the spare room and we can rearrange things a bit.

actions.action: hesitates and then speaks up about her feelings
actions.dialogue: I... I'm not sure about this. I mean, I'm happy for you, Irene, but I was hoping we could keep the space as it is. It feels like a safe place for me right now.
I didn't realize it made you feel that way, Elizabeth. We can talk about it more. I just want to make sure everyone is comfortable.
I guess I don't mind if it's okay with everyone else. But I do want to know what the plan is for space and shared responsibilities.
It's important we all feel heard. Maybe we can set up a time to talk more about it and make sure no one is left out of the conversation.

actions.action: expresses her desire for personal growth and change
actions.dialogue: I just want to make sure this change is what we all need. Sometimes I feel like I'm being overlooked in these decisions, and I want to be part of the solution.

scenes.plot: Elizabeth is finally prompted to express her concerns about the new roommate after Irene casually mentions the possibility. Her anxiety and desire for a more supportive environment come to the surface, while her roommates react with a mix of curiosity, concern, and indifference. The conversation highlights the group's differing perspectives and the emotional weight of shared living decisions.
scenes.social_purpose: To explore Elizabeth's internal conflict about change and her fear of being overlooked, while also demonstrating the dynamics of shared living and the importance of communication and social harmony.
